editorial:
Ever feel like the holidays are just too loud and expensive? That is exactly how Ebenezer Scrooge feels in this colorful animated take on the famous story. You get to follow a grumpy old man who hates everything about Christmas and treats his workers like dirt. The vibe is a mix of spooky and sweet, as Scrooge is forced to look at his own life through the eyes of three different ghosts. It is a cozy watch that manages to make a very old story feel fresh and easy to follow for kids and adults alike.

What really works here is the pacing; it does not drag on, and the animation keeps your eyes busy. The voice acting makes Scrooge feel genuinely mean at first, which makes his change of heart feel earned. While some of the animation might look a bit dated to you now, the heart of the story is still there. You should definitely grab this for a family movie night. If you want the best picture, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV to see those bright colors pop on your big screen.
endingExplained: After seeing his own lonely death in the future, Scrooge wakes up on Christmas morning a totally changed man. He stops being greedy and spends his money to help others. He gives a huge turkey to the Cratchit family and becomes a second father to Tiny Tim. The movie wraps up by showing that it is never too late to be a good person and find happiness through kindness.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic holiday stories and family-friendly animation.
